whenToUse: Playing spoken audio such as episodes, talks, lessons or voice notes from your own files.
Long recordings that need chapters, skip buttons, playback speed and transcript or download links.
avoidWhen: Video, or audio that needs a picture — use video-player.
Short UI sounds or decorative background audio — use a plain audio element with no controls.
a11y: A named group with labelled buttons and a seek slider whose value reads as "1:05 of 45:10"; the current chapter has aria-current.
Keyboard: Space / K play, arrow keys seek 5 s, J / L skip; no autoplay.
